description: Break the commands <-> container bidirectional import cycle by moving web_password_env_file and mitmweb_password_config into src/holon_coherence/container/web_token.py and tightening tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py.
goal: Create src/holon_coherence/container/web_token.py (well under 200 lines) containing web_password_env_file, mitmweb_password_config, and their shared constants (WEB_TOKEN_FILE_MODE, WEB_PASSWORD_ENV_VAR, MITMPROXY_CONFDIR, MITMPROXY_CONFIG_FILENAME) with zero imports from holon_coherence.commands.

Update src/holon_coherence/container/lifecycle.py to import web_password_env_file and mitmweb_password_config from holon_coherence.container.web_token instead of holon_coherence.commands.web_token, and keep src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py re-exporting those symbols from holon_coherence.container.web_token for full backwards compatibility.

Tighten BASELINE_CYCLE_EDGES in tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py by removing the (commands, container) and (container, commands) cycle entries so CI permanently enforces zero commands <-> container cycles, and add unit tests in tests/test_container_web_token.py verifying container.web_token helpers and backwards-compatible commands.web_token re-exports.

Write zero docstrings and zero comments in every new or edited Python file so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Removing the reverse import from container/lifecycle.py into commands/web_token.py eliminates the commands <-> container package cycle cleanly and lets tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py lock it permanently at zero.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/container/web_token.py defines web_password_env_file and mitmweb_password_config with zero imports from commands/, src/holon_coherence/container/lifecycle.py imports them from container/web_token.py, and src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py re-exports them for backwards compatibility.

tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py removes the commands <-> container baseline entries so zero commands <-> container import cycle is enforced, and tests/test_container_web_token.py verifies both container and commands exports under uv run pytest and uv run task lint with zero docstrings or comments and untouched holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
